title: Unemployment by age and duration, UNEM01 SA
description: Seasonally adjusted unemployment for the United Kingdom by age band and duration of unemployment, as a monthly time series. National totals only, with no geographic breakdown.

files.note: The August 2026 release. Sheets: Note, then People, Men and Women, each a time series of levels and rates by age band and duration. United Kingdom totals only, so there is nothing here to draw on a map; kept as context for the local series beside it. Not read by any loader.
